description: This file defines an Angular component named 'Row' which is used as a flexible layout container with customizable alignment and distribution styles. It extends a dynamic component base class and renders its children within a styled <section> element, applying CSS classes based on input properties.

classes.name: Row
classes.description: An Angular component representing a flexible row layout, allowing configuration of alignment and distribution of child elements.

methods.name: alignment
methods.description: Input property defining the alignment of the row's items; defaults to 'stretch'.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Input property defining how the items are distributed within the row; defaults to 'start'.

methods.name: classes
methods.description: A computed property that generates CSS class mappings based on alignment and distribution inputs.
